# poopdeck.gl / SpatioTemporal Tiles (STT)

> Time-aware vector tiles. STT packs large spatiotemporal datasets (points, paths,
> polygons, trips, flows, events) into streamable, animated `.stt` archives;
> poopdeck.gl reads them in TypeScript and renders them with deck.gl (or
> Three.js/WebGPU, MapLibre, Cesium) on a playback clock. An MCP server + Agent
> Skills (the `poopdeck-ai` plugin) are the AI surface.

> **Two repositories, one corpus.** poopdeck.gl owns the renderers, the playback
> engine and this site (<https://github.com/BertCh/poopdeck.gl>). The archive
> format and the Rust CLIs that build, optimize and serve archives are NOT here —
> they live in <https://github.com/BertCh/spatiotemporal-tiles>, and their pages
> below are authored there and vendored into this site.

> **For AI agents:** the entire published documentation corpus is available as a
> single plain-text document at https://poopdeck.gl/llms-full.txt, and every page
> under `docs/{intro,architecture,spec,api,guides}` is mirrored under
> https://poopdeck.gl/llms/. Entries outside that corpus — the roadmap records
> and repo-root files — link to GitHub instead.

## Start here
- [Agent guide (AGENTS.md)](https://github.com/BertCh/poopdeck.gl/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how coding agents should work in this repo.
- [Quickstart](docs/intro/quickstart.md): install, render a hosted dataset, add playback — React or vanilla JS.
- [Concepts](docs/intro/concepts.md): the space×time tile model, packed archives, playback.
- [Choosing an approach](docs/intro/choosing.md): does STT fit; static vs served.
- [Choosing a renderer](docs/intro/choosing-a-renderer.md): which backend, which layer, which playback API.
- [Status and support](docs/intro/status-and-support.md): maturity tiers, compatibility window, and support expectations.
- [Glossary and naming](docs/intro/glossary.md): canonical project, archive, format, and API terminology.
- [CSV quickstart](docs/guides/csv-quickstart.md): fastest path from a table to a map.
- [System overview](docs/architecture/system-overview.md): how the pieces fit.

## Command-line tools (the upstream Rust toolchain)
- [CLI reference](docs/api/cli-reference.md): canonical flags for the five installed binaries — `stt-build`, `stt-optimize`, `stt-validate`, `stt-bundle`, `stt-serve` — plus the repo-only `stt-generate`.
- [Tune & lint tiles](docs/guides/tuning-tiles.md): `stt-optimize` analyze/recommend/inspect/doctor/diff/order-audit; publish encoding.
- [Export an archive](docs/guides/export.md): `stt-optimize export` back to GeoParquet 1.1.
- [Serve & deploy](docs/guides/deploying.md): `stt-serve` and static publishing to a CDN/R2.
- [Data generation](docs/guides/data-generation.md): the reference `stt-generate` datasets, buildable only from the upstream checkout.

## Rendering
- [SpatioTemporalLayer](docs/api/spatiotemporal-layer.md): the deck.gl chassis (time/tier/scrubLod/prefetch props).
- [deck.gl integration](docs/architecture/deckgl-integration.md): how `SpatioTemporalLayer` maps onto `TileLayer`, why the tileset is custom, and where it departs from stock deck.gl.
- [Extensions](docs/api/extensions.md): TimeFilter, DataFilter, CategoryColor, CollisionFilter, ChevronFlow, Splat.
- [Tileset](docs/api/spatiotemporal-tileset.md): `(z, x, y, t)` selection, request scheduling, prefetch, and the buffer model in `@poopdeck.gl/core`.
- [Playback](docs/api/stt-player.md): `SttPlayer`, the facade over the rAF clock and the buffering `PlaybackGovernor`; [React bindings](docs/api/stt-react.md) wrap it in hooks and controls.
- Alternate backends — [Three.js/WebGPU](docs/api/stt-three.md), [MapLibre](docs/api/stt-maplibre.md), [Cesium](docs/api/stt-cesium.md): the non-deck renderers, same decoded tiles.
- [Backend capability matrix](docs/spec/backend-capabilities.md): generated from each backend's `BackendDescriptor` — which capability and layer kind each one implements.

## Format & protocol
- [Packed format spec](docs/spec/stt-packed-format.md): manifest + content-addressed packs, directory v6, quant/zstd.
- [Serve protocol](docs/spec/stt-serve-protocol.md): dynamic tile routes.
- [Time model](docs/spec/time-model.md): buckets, LOD pyramid, temporal bounds.
- [Conformance](docs/spec/conformance.md): what a conformant writer/reader must do, plus the golden fixtures and validator to test against.

## AI-assisted suite
- [AI Suite guide](docs/guides/ai-suite.md): what the suite is (MCP + ten Agent Skills), install the `poopdeck-ai` plugin, worked flows, and the security model.
- [MCP server reference](docs/api/stt-mcp.md): `@poopdeck.gl/mcp` (`stt-mcp`) — dataset discovery, analysis, `@deck.gl/json` map composition, gated build/validate; tools, resources, `--allow-cli`.
- [Plugin](poopdeck-ai/README.md): the `poopdeck-ai` Claude Code plugin bundling the MCP server + Agent Skills.
- [Skills + MCP design record](docs/roadmap/ai-suite.md): the MCP-vs-Skills complementarity verdict, the security model, and the as-built tool/skill inventory.
